ActorTalk: That "standby" could last a while.
Seems the instructors are still searching for us.
Then we're not waiting around.
They would have found us eventually.
What are you doing?
The moment I deleted that data, every security protocol F.O.S. had tied to me went offline.
It won't be long before this place is swarming.
There should be another way.
Our first priority is getting these cuffs off.
For example... me cutting through the canopy of F.O.S. and taking you out of here.
...I don't think that's a viable option.
I won't do it, because... I didn't intend to do it back then either.
What must be abandoned should be abandoned. What must be let go should be let go too.
Since we can't reach a consensus, all that's left to do is—
I've severed the energy link between the cuffs. The physical lock remains, for your security audit.
But in the process... I've left my digital signature all over this hardware.
I'll just keep them to myself, then.
That shouldn't cause issues, right?
Not everything follows your ideal script.
You. That girl. Everyone I crossed paths with here... all traces I failed to "delete."
You can't just "delete" people, you know.
Data aside, connecting with people isn't a bad thing.
Humans are always the most complicated variables. Leaving imprints in their worlds, forging bonds...
It only creates liabilities. That's why I wanted to erase it all.
It's precisely those traces that let us fight side by side before.
It's precisely those traces that made that girl help us.
Tch. You and your sentimental speeches.
Time's up. They'll be here soon. When they get here, improvise. Throw them off the scent.
Goodbye, Alpha.
I don't say goodbye.
